entries.what: Brakes lab at Tamsen Valley College 8-11, then lunch in the truck and a quick shop-floor cleanup. Evening pickup soccer at Delgado Park.
entries.outcome: Lab finished on time; Dante pitched his auction cars again between games.

entries.what: Home in the ranch house off Pell Road, he watched an engine teardown video before bed.
Engine performance class with Salas 1-4, where Rafael's bay got a cleanliness check. Afterward he heard Dulce's mom Yesenia say the hospital was chaos with the new charting system going live.
entries.outcome: Kept his bay clean and avoided a point deduction.

entries.what: Evening at home helping Gladys prep masa tubs and checking the generator.
Brakes lab 8-11, then a stop at Ruiz Family Market where Chuy set aside pork shoulder for Oscar.
entries.outcome: Picked up pork at the family price for chicharrón.

entries.what: Drove Ximena to a cosmetology class and checked her Corolla's tires.

The Taco's battery light flickered on the drive to class and the headlights dimmed at a red light; he diagnosed a failing alternator. He compared three alternator prices and picked a rebuilt one to save $80.
entries.outcome: Ordered the rebuilt alternator to install in the school lab; one-off price comparison for a needed repair.

entries.what: Engine performance 1-4, then worked the Thursday stand shift on the griddle at Delgado Park prep and teardown.
entries.outcome: Got through the evening on a weak battery.

entries.what: Told the assistant over text the alternator whined, the voltage read low and the lights dimmed under load, then asked what the textbook calls that symptom.
entries.outcome: Learned the term and wrote it in his notes.

entries.what: Worked the Friday stand shift, then picked up Dulce from Taquería Colima at 9 p.m. so she wasn't waiting outside.
Worked the family booth at the Calle Ortega Street Fair, running the griddle all afternoon through crowds and music.
entries.outcome: Sold out of revueltas by evening.

entries.what: Teardown of the canopy and generator after the fair, then a pan dulce from Lupe at Las Hermanas.
Sunday stand shift at the Delgado Park market 8-2.
entries.outcome: Steady sales, no problems with the truck.

entries.what: Afternoon nap, then planned the rebuilt alternator install for the lab.
